task: Recover producer onboarding from transient load failure with an explicit retry CTA
problem: A transient failure loading producer onboarding rendered an error with no recovery action and could also show the misleading empty-production state.
implementation: Added an in-place retry CTA that re-runs the onboarding request without leaving the activation funnel.
Clears stale error state before retry and keeps the standard Processing Indicator visible during the async retry.
Suppresses the empty-production state when the request failed, avoiding a false no-production message.
checks: GitHub had not yet emitted a workflow run for the commit at registration time.
expected_impact: Reduces producer activation abandonment after transient API/network failures and protects progression toward agreement, payout activation, event setup and first sale.
next_independent_blocker: Audit checkout/payment visible async states for any remaining non-standard or dead-end error recovery without overlapping the active event-creation P0 claim.
